research.facts:
USA WNT — Six Days to Group Oklahoma
**Source: WBSC.org (wbsc.org/en/events/2026-wbsc-womens-softball-world-cup-group-stage-oklahoma)**
- Tournament dates: September 12-16, 2026 at Devon Park, Oklahoma City
- 6-team field: USA (No. 2 world ranking), Netherlands (No. 6), Mexico (No. 7), China (No. 8), Brazil (No. 17), New Zealand (No. 23)
- Round robin: Sept. 12-15, each team plays 5 games
- Play-off bracket (Sept. 16):
- 5th vs. 6th at 10:00 (consolation)
- 1st vs. 2nd at 13:00 — winner advances directly to 2027 World Cup Finals
- 3rd vs. 4th at 16:00 — winner faces loser of 13:00 game at 19:00 (Repechage)
- Repechage winner = second 2027 World Cup Finals berth
- USA opens vs. Mexico (No. 7) Sept. 12 at 7:30 PM with 6:30 PM opening ceremony
- Destination: 2027 Women's Softball World Cup Finals, Redcliffe, QLD, Australia, April 5-11
- LA28 Olympic qualification path runs through these Finals
**Confidence: HIGH (direct from WBSC official event page)**
**Source: USA Softball / pipeline history (verified prior runs)**
- USA 16-player roster: includes 2020 Olympians Valerie Garcia and Dejah Mulipola
- 7 athletes from 2025 World Games gold medal squad
- Patty Gasso coaches Team USA; also OU head coach
- USA went 5-0 at the International Cup at Devon Park earlier in 2026
- Lexi Kilfoyl won 2026 AUSL All-Star Cup on Aug. 30; is on USA roster
**Confidence: HIGH (confirmed across multiple prior pipeline runs)**

Texas Tech — Week 3 of the Chemistry Lab
**Source: texastech.com, on3.com, SI.com**
- Gerry Glasco: Year 2 as Texas Tech head coach; has Glasco extension through 2030
- Texas Tech was WCWS runner-up in 2026
- Jaysoni Beachum (senior, CI, from FSU): .406 BA, 13 doubles, 10 HR, 69 RBI; 2x All-American
- Kasidi Pickering (senior, OF, from OU): No. 2-ranked transfer per Softball America; .384 career BA, 50 HR in career
- Jayden Heavener (junior, LHP, from LSU): 13-9, 2.81 ERA, 139.1 IP, 128 Ks; NFCA All-Region
- Three different programs, three different cultures (FSU + OU + LSU) in one locker room
- Week 3 of fall camp: transition period from adjustment to identity
